purpose: Prospective small-pilot sensitivity illustration, not post-hoc power.
assumptions: Independent iid binary pair contrasts D in{-1,0,+1}; actual fractional cohort means require another simulation model.

illustrative_mde.model: iid binary pair contrast D in{0,+1}; illustration only

limitation: 10 pairs allow a bounded pilot exact test, not demonstrated power for modest effects or new task/model families.
